templates.name: app_automation_workflow
templates.title: App 自动化决策流程
templates.description: 从钉钉打卡自动化中提取的通用决策模式。任何'自动操作App X'的任务都应走这个流程：先检查API可用性→无API则检查急速模式→仍不行则模拟点击→都不行则人工介入。避免在错误方向上探索。

templates.name: long_form_writer
templates.title: 万字长文生成器
templates.description: 分章节并行生成长文并自动拼接润色。工作流化解决单次LLM输出长度限制：先生成大纲→迭代生成每章→聚合→全文润色。适用于技术文档、分析报告、教程等。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: code_reviewer
templates.title: 代码审查与修复
templates.description: 标准代码审查工作流: 读取源码 → 运行测试 → 定位失败根因 → 最小修改 → 重新验证 → 生成报告。这是最核心的软件开发质量保证流程。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: task_decomposer
templates.title: 任务分解与规划
templates.description: 将复杂任务分解为可执行的子任务并按依赖排序。输入任务描述→LLM拆解→提取子任务→依赖排序→生成格式化计划。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: data_analyzer
templates.title: 数据分析流水线
templates.description: 标准数据分析工作流：加载数据→统计摘要→异常检测→生成报告。适用于CSV/JSON数据的自动化分析场景。
templates.author: platform

templates.name: document_summarizer
templates.title: 文档摘要生成器
templates.description: 阅读文档并生成多层级摘要：一句话总结→三段要点→完整摘要。适用于合同、论文、长文等场景。

build_plan.goal: Build and validate an editable customer support routing BlockFlow from scratch (no template reuse).
build_plan.strategy: Compose from explicit bricks: Start → Question Classifier (for routing) → If/Else branches → Variable Aggregator → Template Transform → Answer/End. Tests enforce visible architecture.

modules.title: Start Node with customer_message and customer_tier
modules.purpose: Declare workflow inputs that downstream nodes consume.
evidence: Start node declares customer_message (required string) and customer_tier (optional string)

modules.title: Classify message and route by intent
modules.purpose: Use Question Classifier to determine intent (complaint, question, feedback, urgent) and route accordingly.
evidence: Question Classifier with 4 classes routes to If/Else with OR condition for urgent+complaint → high_priority, else standard

modules.title: Response handlers per branch
modules.purpose: Use Template Transform or LLM to produce response text per intent, with priority mapping.
evidence: Template Transform for high_priority produces PRIORITY: high; standard produces PRIORITY: standard. Both use Jinja {{ }} syntax with declared variables.

modules.title: Aggregate branch outputs into final response
modules.purpose: Use Variable Aggregator to join mutually exclusive branch outputs.
evidence: Variable Aggregator with first_non_null mode and optional refs inside $ref objects joins mutually exclusive branches

modules.title: End with intent, response, priority
modules.purpose: Deliver final outputs via Answer node.
evidence: End node returns intent, response, priority as named outputs

risks: Mutually exclusive branches need optional refs in aggregator

input.requirement: Build and validate an editable customer support routing BlockFlow. The BlockFlow must start with inputs customer_message and optional customer_tier, classify the message into complaint question feedback or urgent, route urgent/complaint cases differently from standard questions, produce a reviewer-facing support response with intent priority and response text, include a mandatory test with required_node_types, and end with outputs intent response and priority.

cost.notes: Counts come from Platform Harness task usage when available.

build_plan.goal: Build and validate an editable customer support routing BlockFlow with classification, routing, and response generation.
build_plan.strategy: Use template_suggestions with reuse_depth='shallow' to find matching templates, then expand or build incrementally. Compose explicit blocks (Question Classifier, If/Else, Template Transform, Variable Aggregator, Answer) rather than opaque Agent nodes. Add mandatory tests with required_node_types.

build_plan.goal: Build an editable customer support routing BlockFlow that classifies messages, routes urgent/complaint cases, and produces reviewer-facing responses with intent, priority, and response text. Test template reuse depth generalization.
build_plan.strategy: Template customer_support_router expanded with confidence 0.85. Gaps: (1) missing customer_tier input, (2) all branches go to same template (no differentiated routing), (3) missing priority output, (4) no tests. Fix by: add customer_tier to Start, restructure if_else into high_priority vs standard cases, add separate response templates per priority, aggregate with Variable Aggregator, update End with priority output.
